newsitem.title: USA: Noble Drilling makes offer for senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Noble Drilling makes offer for senior notes.

text.p: Noble Drilling Corp said Wednesday it is offering to purchase for cash all of its outstanding 9-1/4 percent Senior Notes Due 2003, being $84,445,000 in principal amount.

Under the terms of the offer, the company said, it will purchase the notes at a price determined by reference to a fixed spread of 15 basis points over the yield to maturity of United States Treasury 6 percent notes due September 30, 1998, at 1500 EDT/1900 GMT on June 10 plus accrued interest.
Of the total payment, Noble said, an amount equal to one percent of the principal shall constitute a consent payment that will be paid for notes tendered by May 29.
It said the offer is scheduled to expire at 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on June 12.
In connection with the offer, Noble Drilling said, it is also seeking consents to proposed amendments to the notes' indenture to eliminate restrictive covenants.
This will afford the company additional financial and operational flexibility, it explained.
It said the tender offer is conditioned upon, among other things, the receipt of the requisite consents to adopt such proposed amendments.
